searchText: Will medalla be mainnet config? Mostly, the min genesis time, deposit contract and most importantly genesis fork version constants are different. Yes, it's the minimum possible derivation of mainnet. Thanks There is a diff to mainnet here: https://gist.github.com/q9f/941b2621214d05ef8759abde30e4f9ef we might want to double down on that issue https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit-cli/issues/52 I'll try it myself now do we have any other tools that allow key generation that maybe do not require python? ethdo (requires go, and you'd have to compile it yourself on osx) Hi <@!557201004060213248> do you want hierarchical key generation? should the keys be in the EIP-2335 keystore format? Would recommend ethdo. We are still finishing up our accounts revamp in Prysm and it isn't 100% ready yet https://github.com/protolambda/eth2-val-tools NOT recommended for mainnet. But very convenient for testnets I'm reviewing the deposit-cli and it does not install on ArchLinux and I saw that it also fails on MacOS, that's why I'm asking. ethdo has pre-compiled linux binaries https://github.com/wealdtech/ethdo/releases
